findings.quote: whose $(i,j)$ entry is the height of the tree node at which observations $i,j$ are together
findings.issue: Two leaves share many ancestral nodes; the cophenetic value requires their lowest common ancestor.
findings.replacement: whose $(i,j)$ entry is the height of their lowest common ancestor, equivalently the last cluster containing both observations before a divisive split separates them
